create_llm_engine: create an LLM engine instance with a model name and configuration kwargs for GPU-based inference
generate_text: generate text outputs from a list of string or integer prompt sequences using sampling parameters
add_request: add a single request to the scheduler with a prompt string or token list and sampling parameters
run_inference_step: run a single inference step that schedules sequences and executes prefill or decode
log_metrics: log final prefill and decode throughput metrics along with speculative decoding acceptance rates
